heading.text: Three notes, each worth more than the last: a step
Every certificate, score report and official lette

headings.text: Habits matter more than the amount In my study of 54 students, 60% of frequent unplanned spenders ran out of money, against 12.5% of the rest.
Research I want to keep doing Investigating financial questions with experienced researchers and economists is both compelling and important to me.

findings.message: 7 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Platform · founder" above "Finaris"; "Research · under review" above "Money habits"; "Mentoring · SAT Makon" above "SAT marathon"; "National program" above "1 of 1,500"; "Scores · March and October 2026" above "SAT 1,310 · IELTS 7.0"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 8 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Selected work", "Platform · founder", "Research · under review", "Mentoring · SAT Makon").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 17 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): article.panel.intro 590px | article.panel 590px | article.panel 590px | article.panel 590px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (6.5:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 862px of the width empty: "Money, not ability, decided who stayed in my class".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.

findings.message: 2 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 716px at 13464px; 420px at 10776px (the screen is 900px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: 2 large-set statement(s) run past 4 lines at 390px: "Habits matter more than the amount In my…" → 6 lines at 22px; "Research I want to keep doing Investigat…" → 5 lines at 22px
findings.fix: A statement set large is about 30 words. Cut it, or set the rest as ordinary body text.

findings.message: 2 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.
